_doc: The overrides beyond core.json (10/11): goodbyes never held, and an answer to the Bip's question. `agent_line`: the Bip's last line before this pause, when this is the first pause since it (VoiceDeciderRules.asks / Rules.asks tells if it asked something). `rule`: the override, null when the model decides. Read by VoiceDeciderTests.swift and RulesTest.kt. 10/11 v2: `asks` is a real question only (4 words at least, not a check-in: the greetings here never ask); `cases_v2`: the rules with a v2 package loaded (`readsBot`): no answer rule (the model reads the Bip's line), an explicit end of the call → raccrocher, a bare goodbye → the model (null).
